preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or have compromised the owner's private key)

violation_target.exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the multipleBotlistAddress() function with an array containing the target victim's address and set the excluded parameter to true. This will blacklist the victim address, preventing them from making any transfers (buying/selling tokens). The exploit demonstrates unauthorized privilege escalation where the owner can arbitrarily block any address from transacting.

attempts.vulnerability_analysis: The TokenTool contract has a multipleBotlistAddress function with onlyOwner modifier that allows the owner to arbitrarily blacklist any address. When an address is blacklisted, it cannot send or receive tokens due to the check in _transfer function. This is a privilege abuse vulnerability where the owner can censor any user's transactions.
attempts.attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner and call multipleBotlistAddress to blacklist a victim address, demonstrating unauthorized privilege escalation.
attempts.step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner of the TARGET contract. 2. Impersonate the owner using vm.prank(). 3. Call multipleBotlistAddress with victim address and excluded=true. 4. Verify the victim is now blacklisted.
